item.title: Mailbox System Update – RSS Integration
item.description:
Hello, Explorer!
You may have noticed something new in your mailbox.
The Internet RPG mailbox is now connected to an external RSS feed!
This means announcements and updates can now be delivered directly to your in-game inbox without requiring a manual update to the userscript.
How it works:
New announcements are retrieved automatically.
Previously imported messages are tracked to prevent duplicates.
New mail can trigger notifications.
Some messages may include claimable XP or Gold attachments.
This message itself was delivered through the new RSS integration!
Consider this a successful system test.
Happy exploring!
— Internet RPG Development Team

item.title: Internet RPG – Beta 4 Released!
item.description:
The Exploration Update is here!
Internet RPG Beta 4 has officially launched!
This update introduces a new layer of exploration, alongside improvements to the game's existing systems.
What's new?
Website exploration tracking and exploration achievements.
The new mailbox system.
RSS-powered announcements and news updates.
Claimable XP and Gold rewards through mail attachments.
New data management options, including Export, Import and Reset.
Thank you for continuing to use Internet RPG!
Enjoy exploring the web. There's more to come.
— Internet RPG Development Team
